subject: Cross-border evidence bucket & staging/cutover plan (UK addendum + DTIA)
messages:
From: Ellis & Co. Legal <privacy@ellisco.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@beaconhealth.org>
Date: 2026-09-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: Evidence for UK Addendum + DTIA mapping (BeaconHealth)

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the quick intro on the call this morning. BeaconHealth's procurement team is running final validation before legal can sign the UK Addendum and the accompanying DTIA. To close out we need the following artifacts by COB Friday (2026-09-18):

- Executed DPA (signature page) and confirmation of the UK Addendum signatory flow;
- A mapping of cross-border flows that shows where BeaconHealth data is processed (primary region + any failover/replication targets);
- Current subprocessors list with onboarding dates and whether they have access to customer content;
- Evidence of contractual safeguards for the US-hosted variant (if failover to US occurs);
- A point of contact for a short SOC2 artifacts handshake if needed.

If you can upload items to a shared folder (or send via DocuSign link for signature pages) that'd be ideal. Let me know if the Friday deadline is feasible.

Regards,
Helen Ellis
Ellis & Co. Legal (on behalf of BeaconHealth)
privacy@ellisco.com

Date: 2026-09-15T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence for UK Addendum + DTIA mapping (BeaconHealth)

Steph / Laura / Helen,

Attaching the initial technical pack for DTIA mapping. Highlights:

- Primary processing region: eu-west-1 (Redwood hosted cluster for BeaconHealth production);
- Replication / failover: asynchronous replicas to us-west-2 (for DR) — customer data remains encrypted at rest (KMS CMKs in region), with strict routing policies (no automated cross-region re-write of customer content outside failover);
- Subprocessors (export): see attached list (subprocessors-20260915.csv) — includes onboarding date, purpose, and whether the subprocess has access to decrypted customer content (yes/no column);
- Network flow diagram attached (network-flow.png) showing egress points and third-party storage endpoints we interact with;
- Notes on safeguards: all cross-border transfers use SCCs per contract; for UK there's an Addendum that references these SCCs and control obligations.

I'll also create a sanitized index (dtia-evidence-index.xlsx) mapping each requested artifact to the contract clause number to speed legal review.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Applied Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments: network-flow.png (png - network diagram), subprocessors-20260915.csv (csv - export), dtia-evidence-index.xlsx (xlsx - index)
From: Ellis & Co. Legal <privacy@ellisco.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@beaconhealth.org>
Date: 2026-09-16T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence for UK Addendum + DTIA mapping (BeaconHealth)

Thanks Vivek — that helps a lot. A couple of clarifying questions before we escalate to procurement:

1) The CSV shows a subprocessors row for "EdgeCache Ltd." in Ireland and a US-based analytics vendor (DataLens Inc.). For the DTIA we need to know whether either subprocessors receive any raw customer content or only telemetry/metrics (please specify columns).
2) For the failover path to us-west-2 — do you have contractual assurances that the US-hosted replica remains within Redwood-controlled infrastructure (i.e., not pushed to a cloud vendor-managed multi-tenant service outside Redwood's control)?
3) Can you provide the signature page for the UK Addendum (we prefer DocuSign envelope) rather than the full DPA PDF you uploaded earlier.

If you can answer 1–2 in-line and upload the signature page we can keep the Friday timeline.

Best,
Helen

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellis & Co. Legal <privacy@ellisco.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Evidence for UK Addendum + DTIA mapping (BeaconHealth)

Hi Helen,

Answers inline below:

1) Subprocessors access: the CSV's "access_type" column indicates either "decrypted-content" or "telemetry-only". EdgeCache Ltd. (Ireland) is telemetry-only (CDN edge logs). DataLens Inc. (US) receives pseudonymized analytics payloads only — no unhashed customer content. I attached the sanitized subprocessor export for your review.

2) Failover contractual assurances: the us-west-2 replica is hosted on Redwood-managed instances within the customer's dedicated cluster/pool; we do not export data to third-party multi-tenant managed services as part of normal failover. We will provide the contractual amendment language confirming Redwood maintains control over the replica environment and KMS keys are region-scoped (no cross-account KMS access).

3) Signature page: attaching a standalone signature page for the UK Addendum via DocuSign request. I'm sending the envelope to your privacy@ellisco.com address and Sam's address. If you prefer we can also upload the PDF to the shared Drive.

Proposed staging/cutover plan:
- Sept 20–22: Upload sanitized artifacts to evidence bucket and send DocuSign envelope (Laura).
- Sept 23: Legal approval window (BeaconHealth legal to confirm).
- Sept 24: Contract execution + DTIA acceptance; procurement to issue PO.
- Sept 25–27: Cutover dry run in staging (no customer traffic).
- Sept 28: Controlled production cutover (if all sign-offs complete).

Connor (Ops) — we'll need a short runbook and single-point rollback plan for the dry run; can you confirm availability?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Compliance & Privacy
Redwood Inference
